title: The Cinematic Oracle
description: A woman in ornate blue and gold robes sits on a gilded throne, holding a crystal ball that displays a detailed cityscape. An old film projector to her left casts light and emits swirling purple smoke containing silhouettes of running figures, while candles, scattered film reels, and a mirror reflecting a face occupy the foreground table.
prompt: A regal woman with pale skin sits on an ornate red and gold throne wearing elaborate blue and gold robes, holding a large crystal ball showing a miniature city inside. To her left an antique film projector beams light and releases thick purple smoke containing ghostly silhouettes of running people. In the foreground a table holds lit candles, scattered film reels, and a small mirror reflecting a face. Dramatic theatrical curtains and classical paintings fill the background, rich cinematic lighting, highly detailed surreal scene.
